groupDistance.basis: Every member sits at the cluster's distance, the Planck 2018 comoving distance of its NED redshift 0.5422 (2,086,405,931.04 pc, the MACS J1149 package's own; the query writes it into each row), spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky: that the cluster is as deep as it is wide is an assumption, not a measurement of any member's depth. The members' own redshifts are not used for depth: inside a cluster they measure motion, not distance.

sample: The 179 galaxies of the 322-row table that Raney, Keeton & Brennan (2020), MNRAS 492, 503 mark as members of MACS J1149: Status = member-spec (spectroscopic cluster member); its 78 photometric members and 65 line-of-sight galaxies are left out. All 179 kept.
meaning: Member galaxies of MACS J1149 flagged by Raney, Keeton & Brennan (2020), MNRAS 492, 503, one dot each at the cluster's distance. Drawn when the cluster is selected.

toneBy.band: HST F814W (AB), the table's F814Wmag, as observed
toneBy.basis: A display scale, not a rest-frame luminosity: each member's magnitude minus the distance modulus of the comoving distance it is placed at (41.60 mag) darkens its color, from full at -23 to 30% at -18, linear in magnitude, the scale Abell 2744's members use; the members run from 18.12 to 23.41 mag. No k-correction is applied and the band differs from cluster to cluster; the table gives no type or color, so every dot is white.

fullDetail.basis: Presentation choice: whole within 6,300 Mpc of the Sun, three times the cluster's distance, so every member shows while the cluster is selected and framed (the bank's origin is the Sun; the renderer's default of 10 kpc suits a galaxy's own dots).
